workouts.description:

2 Sets:
1:15
- Toes to Bar @ Add your Personal Record below - Add your Personal Record below
- Kipping Knees to Elbows
- V-Ups
- Knee Tucks
- Hollow Hold
Rest 2:00 Actively On A Fan Bike
NOTES:
- Same working time as last week but with two fewer sets, because it is a delaod.
- Once you complete the prescribed toes-to-bar, move on to the next movement and work until close to failure before moving to the next movement, and so on. You may not do every movement that is listed, and that is okay.
- If you don't have toes-to-bar, then begin with knees-to-elbows.

accordingly.
